items.title: Bill Mays interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 5, 2025
items.q: I also was, as a member of Bobby Shew’s quintet for many albums and many years, Bobby encouraged me to contribute to the band.

ctx.x: And along the way you felt compelled to become a composer. Can I ask you what kind of circumstances you are inspired by to compose something?

I hadn’t thought of it for decades but when you just asked that, there was an ice cream truck in our neighborhood that had a little tune that went [scats]. And it would drive around and sell sno-cones and fudgesicles. My first composition I wrote an arrangement and I extended his little theme. I don't know what I called it and I don’t remember what it was written for instrumentation-wise, but that’s where the inspiration for that came from. I also was, as a member of Bobby Shew’s quintet for many albums and many…
That’s a great story. And it sort of leads me to do you remember in DownBeat magazine they would do these blindfold tests?
